name: Franzelle Louis Johnson Jr.
office: City of Palmdale, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Franzelle Louis Johnson Jr. is a small business owner running for Palmdale City Council District 3. He holds a degree in behavioral and social science, according to his campaign website. He says the city's biggest need is improving public safety and infrastructure as it grows.
